_comment: Curated starter scripts shipped with SQLExtended for SSMS. Edit this file to add your own. Each script: Name, Category, Description, Body. Ids are generated at load time. After editing, rebuild the extension.

scripts.Name: Drive space (SQL volumes)
scripts.Description: Total / free / used space for every volume that hosts a database file.
scripts.Body:
SELECT DISTINCT
    vs.volume_mount_point                                                       AS Drive,
    vs.logical_volume_name                                                      AS VolumeName,
    CAST(vs.total_bytes      / 1073741824.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))                    AS TotalGB,
    CAST(vs.available_bytes  / 1073741824.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))                    AS FreeGB,
    CAST((vs.total_bytes - vs.available_bytes) / 1073741824.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UsedGB,
    CAST(vs.available_bytes * 100.0 / vs.total_bytes AS DECIMAL(5,2))            AS FreePercent
FROM sys.master_files AS mf
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_os_volume_stats(mf.database_id, mf.file_id) AS vs
ORDER BY Drive;

scripts.Name: SQLExtended file sizes
scripts.Description: Size and used space of every data/log file in the current database.
scripts.Body:
SELECT
    df.name                                            AS LogicalName,
    df.type_desc                                       AS FileType,
    df.physical_name                                   AS PhysicalPath,
    CAST(df.size / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))             AS SizeMB,
    CAST(FILEPROPERTY(df.name, 'SpaceUsed') / 128.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS UsedMB
FROM sys.database_files AS df
ORDER BY df.type, df.name;

scripts.Name: Top 20 queries by avg CPU
scripts.Description: Cached plans ranked by average worker (CPU) time. Useful for spotting expensive statements.
scripts.Body:
SELECT TOP (20)
    qs.execution_count,
    qs.total_worker_time / qs.execution_count       AS AvgCpuTime,
    qs.total_elapsed_time / qs.execution_count      AS AvgElapsedTime,
    SUBSTRING(st.text, (qs.statement_start_offset / 2) + 1,
        ((CASE qs.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
          ELSE qs.statement_end_offset END - qs.statement_start_offset) / 2) + 1) AS StatementText
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY AvgCpuTime DESC;
